title: Connexions projectives et uniformisation : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (cote 159, projective connections and uniformization). The preceding page studies the de Rham bundle DR = H^1_dR(X/S) of a family of curves f: X -> S over T. DR carries the Hodge filtration 0 -> Omega = f_*omega -> DR -> Omega^vee -> 0. A Gauss-Manin type map DR -> DR (x) Omega^1_{S/T} fails to respect the filtration, and the failure gives a map V_{S/T} -> Omega^vee (x) Omega^vee (Kodaira-Spencer / second fundamental form). In the VA (abelian variety) case it factors through the symmetric part because of the polarization. That page also introduces a torsor Sigma under Lambda^2 Omega.

This page continues the thread.
(1) Heading: splittings of the Hodge filtration of DR correspond to 'admissible' differential forms phi on DR, i.e. splittings of the Hodge filtration viewed as forms.
(2) The sequence 0 -> Gamma^2 Omega -> Omega (x) Omega -> Lambda^2 Omega -> 0, with Gamma^2 the symmetric tensors (char != 2). Multiplication gives Gamma^2 Omega -> f_*(omega^2), and f_*(omega^2) ~ Omega^1_{S/T} by Kodaira-Spencer and Serre duality on the moduli. This map is an epimorphism in the non-hyperelliptic case: Max Noether's theorem, i.e. the dual statement that the differential of the Torelli map is injective off the hyperelliptic locus.
(3) Dimension check: g(g+1)/2 - (3g-3) = (g-2)(g-3)/2. This is the rank of the kernel, the space of quadrics through the canonical curve (Petri). The arithmetic is correct.
(4) Fragments: an Atiyah-type sequence, apparently 0 -> O -> (first-order operators) -> omega^{-1} -> 0. The action E (x)_O P -> E of principal parts or operators. The Euler characteristic 2-2g. P^infty_{X/S}, and Omega, Omega^2, Omega^3 (graded pieces).
(5) The principal-parts sequence for omega, 0 -> omega^2 = Omega^1_{X/S} (x) omega -> P^1_{X/S}(omega) -> omega -> 0. Pushing forward, and using R^1 f_* omega^2 = 0 for g >= 2, gives 0 -> f_*(omega^2) = Omega^1_{S/T} -> f_*P^1(omega) -> Omega -> 0. This is an extension of the Hodge bundle by the cotangent bundle of moduli, the natural ambient for projective connections, which form a torsor under f_*omega^2 = Omega^1.
(6) Recollection of the algebraic definition of principal parts: J = ker(A (x) A -> A), with J/J^2 = Omega^1 generated by the classes of x(x)1 - 1(x)x (written x(x)y - y(x)x on the page). P^infty(omega^n) carries two module structures, omega (x) P^infty versus P^infty (x) omega. Twisting M (x) P^infty uses the vanishing R^1 f_*(M (x) omega^n) = 0 for n >= 1.
(7) Definition of a graded algebra S^* = sum_{n>=0} f_*(omega^n (x) P^infty), a 'principal parts' or jet thickening of the relative canonical ring Sigma = f_*(sum omega^n). It sits in a diagram Sigma^* -> S^* <- R^*, with Sigma (x) R^*, and a question about generation and grading. The aim is apparently to encode projective connections or uniformizing data through a jet-enriched canonical algebra over moduli.
errors: No mathematical errors visible. The surjectivity of Gamma^2 Omega -> f_*omega^2 correctly requires non-hyperelliptic (and g >= 3); the char != 2 caveat for Gamma^2 versus Sym^2 is correctly noted.
The identification f_*(omega^2) ~ Omega^1_{S/T} holds only for a (locally) universal family; it is implicitly assumed from the previous page.
The algebra S^* is only sketched; its generation and grading are left as questions (unfinished).

ideas.what: Multiplication Sym^2 f_*omega -> f_*omega^2 = Omega^1_{M_g}, surjective off the hyperelliptic locus; kernel rank (g-2)(g-3)/2
ideas.modern_name: Max Noether theorem / Petri; codifferential of the Torelli map (infinitesimal Torelli)
ideas.usually_credited_to: M. Noether, Petri; Oort-Steenbrink (1980) for Torelli map immersion

ideas.what: Splittings of the Hodge filtration of H^1_dR as 'admissible forms'; Gauss-Manin second fundamental form
ideas.modern_name: Hodge filtration splittings, Kodaira-Spencer / Griffiths transversality

ideas.what: Principal parts sequence 0 -> omega^2 -> P^1(omega) -> omega -> 0 pushed forward to an extension of Hodge bundle by Omega^1_{M_g}
ideas.modern_name: jet bundles / projective connections as twisted cotangent torsor over M_g
ideas.usually_credited_to: EGA IV 16 (principal parts); for projective structures over moduli: Hubbard, Tyurin, Beilinson-Kazhdan, Ben-Zvi-Frenkel

ideas.modern_name: jet / principal-parts canonical algebra (closest: algebra of jets of modular forms, Rankin-Cohen-type structures)

It seems aimed at encoding projective connections / uniformization algebraically. The construction is left unfinished.

missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a modest unfinished thread. Jet extensions of canonical rings over M_g relate to opers and projective structures over moduli, but the specific algebra does not appear to be a standard object.

deep.surprise_reason: Mostly classical material (Noether/Petri count, infinitesimal Torelli, principal parts, Hodge filtration) worked out privately. Only the sketched jet-canonical algebra is mildly nonstandard, and it is too fragmentary to assess.
transcription_corrections: 'P^{3+}_{X/S}' is most likely P^1_{X/S}(omega) (first-order principal parts of omega), given the sequence 0 -> omega^2 -> P -> omega -> 0.
The line read '0 -> Omega -> omega^{-1}' likely begins with O_X (structure sheaf) and is an Atiyah/differential-operator sequence 0 -> O -> D^{<=1} -> omega^{-1} -> 0, partly crossed out.
'Epi (cas non hyperelliptique)' annotation: also mentions char != 2; f_*(omega^2) ~ Omega^1_{S/T} is correct.
Underlined handwritten text under the dimension count reads (g-2)(g-3).
